note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English: alate, soldier and worker are all treated; measurements are taken from the text; synonymy lists, literature citations, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow to yellow; antennae pale yellow to pale brown; mandibles reddish; thorax and legs pale yellow; abdomen transparent, intestinal contents visible. Head sparsely hairy, body rather densely hairy. Body length 3.50–5.60 mm. Head oval, narrowing anteriorly, thick; frons sloping at about 45° at the front of the head (length to mandibular base 1.07–1.44, maximum width 0.85–1.15 mm). Fontanelle transverse, situated anteriorly, a short distance behind the postclypeus; surrounded by several hairs. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Clypeus bilobed. Labrum broad, ligulate. Mandibles slender and long, strongly incurved in the posterior half, more or less falcate, broad at the base (length 0.58–0.80 mm); each with one posteriorly directed pointed tooth at about the middle. Postmentum rather arched; subrectangular, weakly narrowed on both sides near the posterior end (length 0.70–0.90, maximum width 0.28–0.35, minimum width 0.23–0.30 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.28–0.40, width 0.56–0.78 mm); anterior margin shallowly concave, posterior margin nearly straight or shallowly concave.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to pale yellowish brown; antennae, thorax and legs paler. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 4.0–5.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to clypeal apex 1.17–1.75, length to mandibular base 0.75–0.87, maximum width 0.91–1.07 mm). Antennae 14-segmented; segment 4 shortest, segment 3 shorter than segment 2. Postclypeus inflated, projecting posteriorly into the frons, anterior margin nearly straight, half as long as wide (length 0.23–0.25, width 0.45–0.50 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.25–0.35, width 0.60–0.70 mm); median concavity of the anterior part weak. Apical tibial spurs 3:2:2, dorsal spurs sometimes indistinct.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown; postclypeus yellowish brown; antennae and legs paler than the postclypeus; pronotum paler than the head; abdominal tergites paler than the pronotum. Head and body densely covered with short fine hairs and long hairs. Body length (without wings) about 5.0–6.30 mm. Head capsule subcircular, length to mandibular base about equal to the width without eyes (length to clypeal apex 1.04–1.23, length to mandibular base 0.70–0.78, width with eyes 0.74–0.81 mm); slightly concave around the fontanelle. Fontanelle small, with an oval extension anteriorly. Compound eyes circular, medium-sized, weakly projecting (0.21–0.28 × 0.20 mm), situated below the lower margin of the head by less than to about half their diameter (0.08–0.12 mm). Ocelli oval (0.10–0.14 × 0.06–0.09 mm), separated from the compound eye by about their short diameter or slightly more. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 2 as long as segments 3 and 4 together; segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, as densely hairy as the head; anterior margin straight, posterior margin rounded; divided in the middle by an incomplete dark line (length 0.24, width 0.45 mm). Labrum domed. Left mandible with one finger-like apical tooth and one lobed marginal tooth; marginal tooth shorter than the apical tooth, its posterior margin long. Right mandible with a finger-like apical tooth and two marginal teeth; marginal tooth 1 shorter than the apical tooth, its posterior margin slightly long; marginal tooth 2 short, its posterior margin long and straight; molar plate longer than the posterior margin of marginal tooth 2. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal; anterior margin slightly raised, weakly concave in the middle; posterior margin weakly convex, shallowly concave (length 0.48–0.58, width 0.71–0.89 mm).
